english: Then I disagree with the third part of the reason from before: I disagree that there are many examples of things which are not working things but are still knowable things. If you do disagree, then let's consider working things. It is so the case that there are many examples of things which are not working things but are still knowable things, Because unchanging things would be one example, and existence itself would be another. 3 If Something Is a Quality For a Working Thing, Does It Have to Be a Quality For the Ability to Perform a Function?
